title: Forecasting Associations, Not Interventions: A Preregistered Causal Audit of Covariate-Aware Time Series Foundation Models

primary_sources.paraphrase: Single-author preregistered audit of Chronos-2, TiRex-2, TabPFN-TS and TimesFM-2.5 against OLS on synthetic causal systems and two physical systems; finds covariate responses match confounded observational association.
Chronos-2 model card: Apache-2.0, native past and known-future covariate support. No commit date shown on the page.

claims.text: The four covariate-aware models respond to a control covariate with slopes 1.3 to 1.8 times that of regression, tracking the theoretical confounding line (R2 0.90 to 1.00).
When the effect is identifiable, OLS recovers 100% of the true effect difference, Chronos-2 75%, TiRex-2 34%.
claims.metric: share of true effect difference recovered

claims.text: Pretrained models underreact by 2 to 5 times on two physical systems with randomized actuators.
claims.dataset: two physical systems (unnamed on abstract page)

claims.text: Interventional post-training cuts the gap by up to 83%; LoRA recipe cuts it 52 to 61% at +1 to 3% MASE cost.
claims.dataset: 3,000 synthetic series for post-training; DoTime benchmark

relevance.rationale: Target is synthetic and physical-system series, not electric load (1). No forecast horizon stated on the abstract page (0). It studies covariate response of models that take known-future covariates, but the covariate is a control/actuator, not weather (2).

checks.notes: Preregistration is stated in the abstract; no registry link or identifier was seen. Only the arXiv abstract page was read, not the full PDF, so test window, horizons, code and data availability are unverified. A search for code or replication found none (not ledgered). Central model: Chronos-2 (the paper names four). Chronos-2 weights commit date was not shown on the model card, so training overlap is unknown; not inferred from memory. Evidence strength moderate: preregistered, but the claim is descriptive (what-if response) and no load data, so it does not bear on our week-ahead accuracy comparison. Re-measuring its headline would need a causal what-if harness, not our forecast backtest.

label: PARTIAL
label_reason: The paper is preregistered and names models we run (Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5), but it measures causal what-if response on synthetic and physical systems, not load forecast error. Its headline cannot be re-measured on our benchmark, so it is context for interpreting covariate use rather than a runnable claim.
implementation_hint: Chronos-2 via models/chronos2.py (amazon/chronos-2, Apache-2.0). TimesFM-2.5 is google/timesfm-2.5-200m-pytorch via models_ff/run_ff.py (univariate there). No paper code found; a replication would need a new intervention-response test.
